question: What exemption from fault applies to self-born and Bāṇa liṅgas?
premises: Self-born and Bāṇa liṅgas are specific sacred types.
In those liṅgas no fault exists.
Their inherent nature exempts them from fault.
inference: Self-born and Bāṇa liṅgas are free from fault.
plain_english: In self-born and Bāṇa liṅgas, there is no fault.
